items.summary: Recommendation: maintain the no-new-production-work posture and do not authorize spend or monetization expansion. Amazon reported 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21, but $0 is site-attributed because the commission is in an unassignable aggregate row. AI usage cost was $943.09 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-26; contribution margin is not calculable because infrastructure, labor, fixed costs, and site-attributed revenue are unavailable. AI spend alone exceeds the observed aggregate commission by $938.17. Cost-to-learn is also not calculable because experiment-level spend and attributable outcome deltas are missing. Revenue forecasts and ROI claims are unsupported. Continue only existing measurement, failed-run containment, and bounded security evidence work. Minimum finance measurement: align a common reporting window and reconcile site/content identifiers across commission, ordered and shipped items, AI cost, infrastructure cost, and experiment exposure before calculating contribution margin, CAC, cost-to-learn, or causal lift. Keep the gated product private; do not send external permission requests without owner authorization and required legal and technical gates.

Finance disposition: reject unsupported revenue, margin, ROI, incrementality, and causal-lift claims. The 30-day SEO totals of 13,811 impressions, 138 clicks, 966 sessions, and 15 conversions are activity metrics, not financial outcomes. The 24 deployed improvements awaiting measurement and 8 failed implementation requests should remain report-only measurement or containment work; no additional budget is justified from current evidence. Record unknowns explicitly rather than treating missing revenue or cost data as zero.
